statement.p: If \cos(\phi) = 0.7087 and 3 \pi /2 \leq \phi \leq 2 \pi, approximate the following to four decimal places.

static.solution:
SOLUTION
a) We begin by using the Pythagorean Identity to find \sin{ ( \phi ) }. Since \sin^2{ ( \phi )} + \cos^2{ ( \phi ) } =1, we have
\sin^2{ ( \phi ) } + \left( 0.7087 \right)^2 = 1
\sin^2{ ( \phi ) } = 1 - \left( 0.7087 \right)^2
\sin{ ( \phi ) } = \pm \sqrt{0.4977} \approx \pm 0.7055 .
Since 3 \pi /2 \leq \phi \leq 2 \pi, \sin{ ( \phi ) } is negative, so \sin{ ( \phi ) } \approx - 0.7055.
b) \tan{ ( \phi ) }= \frac{ \sin{ ( \phi )}}{\cos{ ( \phi )}} = \frac{- 0.7055}{0.7087} \approx -0.9955
